The '''Servant ion/repulsorlift engine''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] produced by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]]. A hybrid [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] and [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]], the Servant was utilized on the [[Talon I combat cloud car]]. Located at the rear of the craft, the engine was slung low and exposed to the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] for increased [[Temperature/Legends|cooling]] performance. The engine's hybrid design allowed the craft to reach a maximum altitude of 100 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]],<ref name="EGVV" /> as well as a maximum speed of 1,500 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]].<ref name="FF">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 101|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 101]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Servant engine was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book written by [[Bill Smith]]. The book contained artwork by [[Doug Chiang]] and schematics by [[Troy Vigil]], and it was published on [[March 19]], [[1996]] as part of [[Del Rey]]'s [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|''Essential Guides'']] series.<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=delrey/starwars/catalog/display.pperl?isbn=9780345392992|text=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels}}</ref>
